build_kinematic_relationship_manager: build a KinematicRelationshipManager instance attached to a Habitat simulator to track object kinematic relationships
add_relation_to_graph: add a parent-child relationship with a relationship type string to the RelationshipGraph
apply_relationships_snapshot: apply cached parent-to-child transformation matrices to update object positions in the simulation
get_human_readable_relationship_forest: get a human-readable dictionary of object relationship trees with named objects and relationship types
remove_obj_relations: remove all kinematic relationships for an object from the RelationshipGraph when it is grasped or removed
